arxiv-2009-12928.title: A Weighted Quiver Kernel using Functor Homology
arxiv-2009-12928.creator: Manohar Kaul, Dai Tamaki
arxiv-2009-12928.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a new homological method to study weighted directed networks. Our model of such networks is a directed graph Q Q equipped with a weight function w w on the set Q 1 Q_{1} of arrows in Q Q .

arxiv-2207-13167.title: One Simple Trick to Fix Your Bayesian Neural Network
arxiv-2207-13167.creator: Piotr Tempczyk, Ksawery Smoczyński, Philip Smolenski-Jensen, Marek Cygan
arxiv-2207-13167.description: Abstract One of the most popular estimation methods in Bayesian neural networks (BNN) [ Blundell et al. 2015 ] is mean-field variational inference (MFVI) [ Blei et al. 2017 ] . In this work, we show that neural networks with ReLU [ Fukushima 1975 ] activation function induce posteriors, that are hard to fit with MFVI.

arxiv-2303-03282.title: Learning Object Manipulation With Under-Actuated Impulse Generator Arrays
arxiv-2303-03282.creator: C. Kong, W. S. Yerazunis, D. Nikovski
arxiv-2303-03282.description: Abstract For more than half a century, vibratory bowl feeders have been the standard in automated assembly for singulation, orientation, and manipulation of small parts. Unfortunately, these feeders are expensive, noisy, and highly specialized on a single part design bases.

arxiv-2403-15880.title: Semiclassical Limit of the Bogoliubov–de Gennes Equation
arxiv-2403-15880.creator: Jacky J. Chong, Laurent Lafleche, Chiara Saffirio
arxiv-2403-15880.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jacky J. Chong, Laurent Lafleche, Chiara Saffirio. In this paper, we rewrite the time-dependent Bogoliubov–de Gennes equation in an appropriate semiclassical form and establish its semiclassical limit to a two-particle kinetic transport equation with an effective mean-field background potential satisfying the one-particle Vlasov equation. Moreover, for some semiclassical regimes, we obtain a higher-order correction to the two-particle kinetic transport equation, capturing a nontrivial two-body interaction effect. The convergence is proven for C 2 C^{2} interaction potentials in terms of a semiclassical optimal transport pseudo-metric.

arxiv-2411-05556.title: Gaussian process modelling of infectious diseases using the Greta software package and GPUs
arxiv-2411-05556.creator: Eva Gunn, Nikhil Sengupta, Ben Swallow
arxiv-2411-05556.description: Abstract Gaussian process are a widely-used statistical tool for conducting non-parametric inference in applied sciences, with many computational packages available to fit to data and predict future observations. We study the use of the Greta software for Bayesian inference to apply Gaussian process regression to spatio-temporal data of infectious disease outbreaks and predict future spread.

arxiv-2504-18092.title: The Evolution of Heavy Ion Abundances with Solar Activity
arxiv-2504-18092.creator: B. L. Alterman, Y. J. Rivera, S. T. Lepri, J. M. Raines, R. D’Amicis
arxiv-2504-18092.description: Abstract Context. When observed at 1 ​ AU 1\,\mathrm{AU} , solar wind with slow speeds ( v sw ≲ 500 ​ km ​ s − 1 v_{\mathrm{sw}}\lesssim 500\;\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}} ) is typically considered to have originated in source regions with magnetic topologies that are intermittently open to the heliosphere.

arxiv-2505-24850.title: Harnessing Negative Signals: Reinforcement Distillation from Teacher Data for LLM Reasoning
arxiv-2505-24850.creator: Shuyao Xu Cheng Peng Jiangxuan Long Weidi Xu Wei Chu Yuan Qi
arxiv-2505-24850.description: Abstract Recent advances in model distillation show that data from advanced reasoning models can effectively train smaller student models. However, standard practices discard incorrect reasoning traces—valuable, yet underutilized data. This paper addresses the critical question: How can both positive and negative distilled reasoning traces be effectively leveraged to maximize LLM reasoning performance in an offline setting?

arxiv-2507-10820.title: Semantic Context for Tool Orchestration
arxiv-2507-10820.creator: Robert Müller
arxiv-2507-10820.description: Abstract This paper demonstrates that Semantic Context (SC), leveraging descriptive tool information, is a foundational component for robust tool orchestration. Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a theoretical foundation using contextual bandits, introducing SC-LinUCB and proving it achieves lower regret and adapts favourably in dynamic action spaces.

arxiv-2508-20486.title: Monodromy Equivalence for Lamé-type Equations I: Finite-gap Structures and Cone Spherical Metrics.
arxiv-2508-20486.creator: Ting-Jung Kuo, Xuanpu Liang, Ping-Hsiang Wu
arxiv-2508-20486.description: Abstract . Motivated by the finite-gap structure of the classical Lamé equation ( 1.2 ) and its central role in mathematical physics, generalized Lamé-type equations ( 1.12 ) are investigated. For the fundamental case n = 1 n=1 , a monodromy equivalence between the classical Lamé equation ( 1.18 ) and the generalized Lamé-type equation ( 1.19 ) is established.

arxiv-2601-15831.title: Performance Analysis of Digital Beamforming mmWave MIMO with Low-Resolution DACs/ADCs
arxiv-2601-15831.creator: Faruk Pasic 1 , Mariam Mussbah 1 2 , Stefan Schwarz 1 , Markus Rupp 1 , Fredrik Tufvesson 3 , and Christoph F. Mecklenbräuker 1
arxiv-2601-15831.description: Abstract Future wireless communications will rely on MIMO ( MIMO ) beamforming operating at MMW ( MMW ) frequency bands to deliver high data rates. To support flexible spatial processing and meet the demands of latency-critical applications, it is essential to use fully digital MMW MIMO beamforming, which relies on accurate channel estimation.

britannica-1911-fortescue-sir-john-state.title: Fortescue, Sir John (statesman) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fortescue-sir-john-state.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fortescue-sir-john-state.description: Article 'Fortescue, Sir John (statesman)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was the eldest son of Sir Adrian Fortescue (executed in 1539), and of his second wife, Anne, daughter of Sir William Reade or Rede of Borstall in Buckinghamshire. The exact date of his birth is unrecorded. He was restored in blood and to his estate at Shirburn in Oxfordshire in 1551.

pmc-10604263.title: Life-History and Ecological Correlates of Egg and Clutch Mass Variation in Sympatric Bird Species at High Altitude
pmc-10604263.creator: Yuxin Liu, Xiaolong Du, Guopan Li, Yingbao Liu, Shaobin Li, Wen Bo Liao, Wei Chen, Ying Jiang, Chan Zhang, Lixia Zhang
pmc-10604263.description: Simple SummaryThis study intended to understand the variation in egg and clutch mass among coexisting bird species at high altitudes. We investigated several life-history or ecological factors that could explain this variation. The results show that both egg and clutch mass were related to body mass across species.

pmc-11476478.title: Impact of Mobile Health Literacy, Stroke-Related Health Knowledge, Health Beliefs, and Self-Efficacy on the Self-Care Behavior of Patients with Stroke
pmc-11476478.creator: Hana Kim, Aro Han, Hyunjung Lee, Jiwoo Choi, Hyohjung Lee, Mi-Kyoung Cho
pmc-11476478.description: Background: The recent substantial increase in the incidence of stroke cases has resulted in high medical expenses. Stroke necessitates ongoing care, emphasizing the importance of consistent self-management. The occurrence of stroke impacts healthcare costs and has far-reaching effects on social services, encompassing disability, unemployment, and other related concerns beyond individuals and families.

pmc-11607814.title: Replacement of a single-tooth implant restoration with the abutment dual-scanning technique: a case report
pmc-11607814.creator: Fatmanur Demir Boz, Kıvanç Akça
pmc-11607814.description: BackgroundDigital technologies have not only revolutionized workflow strategies for implant- supported fixed prostheses but also changed preferences in the choice of restoration retention. Owing to the effortlessness of developing workflows with digitalization, screw-retention has become favored for initial prostheses. However, cement retention is still indicated for cases in which abutment reuse is needed for replacing failing restorations with technical complications.

pmc-11728450.title: Innovative One-Step Sustainable Process to Produce Simonkolleite Nanoparticles
pmc-11728450.creator: Valeria Daniele, Claudia Mondelli, Laura Turilli, Giuliana Taglieri
pmc-11728450.description: The aim of the present paper is to propose an innovative, one-step and sustainable process allowing us to obtain almost 10 kg/week of pure and crystalline simonkolleite nanoparticles (SK NPs) in only 8 min of reaction, working in water, under ambient conditions of pressure/temperature, guaranteeing at the same time low environmental impact and a high yield of NP production.

pmc-12540905.title: Integrating machine learning and protein–ligand interaction profiling for the discovery of METTL3 inhibitors
pmc-12540905.creator: Wei-Cheng Huang, Hsing-Pang Hsieh, Chun-Wei Tung
pmc-12540905.description: RNA modifications are critical in regulating gene expression and cell functions by affecting RNA stability, splicing, translation, and degradation. The catalytic core of N6-adenosine-methyltransferase catalytic subunit METTL3 has emerged as a key enzyme in tumorigenesis by enhancing the translation efficiency of oncogenic transcripts, which is a promising therapeutic target for cancers, including acute myeloid leukemia.

pmc-12655520.title: Modern Approaches and Emerging Biological Therapies to Treat Fracture Nonunion
pmc-12655520.creator: Julian Wier, Hannah Shelby, Sarah Bergren, Joseph T. Patterson, Jay R. Lieberman
pmc-12655520.description: Fracture nonunion remains an unresolved complication after extremity fracture, with notable costs to patient quality of life and health systems. Nonunion is defined by the inability of fracture ends to unite without evidence of progressive healing over time. Approximately 2 to 10% of all fractures go onto nonunion, with increased rates observed in specific fracture locations and patient populations.

pmc-12743568.title: Analysis of the Correlation Between Serum Procalcitonin (PCT), C-Reactive Protein (CRP) Levels and the Occurrence/Severity of Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia in ELBW/VLBW Neonates
pmc-12743568.creator: Jiaan Wang, Shu Zhang, Xian Dong, Jinwen Chen, Ming Li
pmc-12743568.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to analyze the correlation between serum levels of Procalcitonin (PCT) and C-reactive protein (CRP) and the occurrence and severity of Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia (BPD) in Extremely Low Birth Weight (ELBW) and Very Low Birth Weight (VLBW) neonates, and to identify associated risk factors.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on 213 ELBW/VLBW neonates admitted between January 2021 and January 2024.

pmc-12748411.title: Targeting ferroptosis by noncoding RNAs as a novel therapeutic strategy for hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12748411.creator: Yaser Mohammadi, Mohammad Ali Mahdiabadi, Zahra Ourang, Elham Bahreini, Ali Abaszade-Cheragheali
pmc-12748411.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), the most common primary liver cancer, is recognized as the third leading cause of cancer-related deaths. Late diagnosis and limited treatment efficacy are among the major challenges of HCC. Recent studies have introduced ‘ferroptosis’—a unique iron-dependent cell death mechanism driven by lipid peroxidation, accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS), and oxidative imbalance—as a promising therapeutic approach for HCC.

pmc-12751862.title: Genomic origin and consequence of captive red junglefowl in zoological parks
pmc-12751862.creator: Yuki Matsuda, Masaki Eda, Shuichi Ito, Tsuyoshi Shimmura
pmc-12751862.description: Understanding the genetic status of captive animal populations is essential for their long-term conservation and effective management. In this study, we investigated the genetic origin, admixture patterns, and genomic health of red junglefowls (Gallus gallus; RJFs) maintained in zoological parks (zooRJFs).

pmc-12754788.title: Improving accuracy in genome-wide association studies: a two-step approach for handling below limit of detection biomarker measurements
pmc-12754788.creator: Yaqi A Deng, Torgny Karlsson, Åsa Johansson
pmc-12754788.description: Advances in high-throughput technologies enable large-scale studies on genomics and molecular phenotypes. However, the trade-off between quality and quantity reduces assay sensitivity, and several measurements in large-scale proteomics and metabolomics analytes fall below the limit of detection (LOD). If not properly addressed, this may introduce bias in effect estimates.

pmc-12785904.title: Radiomic-Based Machine Learning Classifiers for HPV Status Prediction in Oropharyngeal Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis †
pmc-12785904.creator: Anna Luíza Damaceno Araújo, Luiz Paulo Kowalski, Alan Roger Santos-Silva, Brendo Vinícius Rodrigues Louredo, Cristina Saldivia-Siracusa, Otávio Augusto A. M. de Melo, Deivid Cabral, Andrés Coca-Pelaz, Orlando Guntinas-Lichius, Remco de Bree, Pawel Golusinski, Karthik N. Rao, Robert P. Takes, Nabil F
pmc-12785904.description: Background: The aim of the present systematic review (SR) is to compile evidence regarding the use of radiomic-based machine learning (ML) models for predicting human papillomavirus (HPV) status in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) patients and to assess their reliability, methodological frameworks, and clinical applicability. The SR was conducted following PRISMA 2020 guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD42025640065).

pmc-12846508.title: Vaccine Hesitancy and Refusal Among Parents of Children Aged 5–11 Years: Evidence from the COVID-19 Pandemic in the Calabria Region
pmc-12846508.creator: Francesca Licata, Concetta Arianna Scicchitano, Emma Antonia Citrino, Aida Bianco
pmc-12846508.description: Background/Objectives: This study aims to evaluate COVID-19 parental vaccine hesitancy (CPVH) and refusal among parents of children between 5 and 11 years and to identify potential factors influencing them. A secondary aim was to assess knowledge, concerns, and beliefs associated with COVID-19 and immunization.

pmc-12919895.title: Validation of the important role and prognostic value of KIF14 in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-12919895.creator: Jingjing Yuan, Meilin Zhang, Yaxuan Liu, Yiran Qiu, Mingdi Zhang, Hongliang Chen
pmc-12919895.description: BackgroundTriple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive subtype with a poor prognosis and limited treatment options. Elevated Kinesin Family Member 14 (KIF14) expression in breast cancer (BC) is correlated with poor prognosis, but its role in TNBC remains unclear.MethodsKIF14 expression was analyzed using TCGA, TIMER, and GEO databases, and its association with prognosis was assessed via Kaplan‒Meier plotter.

pmc-13049948.title: Back in stride: patient perspectives on operative and nonoperative treatment and recovery after acute proximal hamstring avulsions – a qualitative study
pmc-13049948.creator: Anne-Mari N. Rosenlund, Jorunn Thaulow, Kjell Erling Kjellman, Charlotte Myhre Jensen, Lars Nordsletten, Kenneth Jonsson, Frede Frihagen
pmc-13049948.description: BackgroundPatient-reported outcome measures indicate favorable results after both operative and nonoperative treatment of acute proximal hamstring avulsions. However, little is known about the patients´ experience with treatment and recovery. The aim of this study was to explore the patient perspective on proximal hamstring avulsions, spanning the trajectory from injury through treatment and rehabilitation to the final outcome.

pmc-13219503.creator: Fei Tu, Fengyuan He, Zhiyuan Li, Yiqing Jia, Lingzhu Wang, Tiesuo Zhao, Sheng Guo, Yan Jin, Zhijun Yang

pmc-13245168.title: IVUS catheter entrapment and percutaneous retrieval: case report and literature review
pmc-13245168.creator: Fintan Corvan, Aaron Peace, Jack Andrews, Dzan Horozic, Joon Heng Tan, Deepti Ranganathan
pmc-13245168.description: Background2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of chronic coronary syndromes updated their recommendation for intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) guidance of PCI on anatomically complex lesions, particularly left main, bifurcations and long lesions to class 1, level A evidence. With more widespread use complex PCI operators are more likely to encounter complications and require an awareness of potential solutions.

pmc-13414928.title: Salt–Drought Co-Stress Impairs Root Ultrastructure, Remodels Rhizosphere Bacteria, and Suppresses Peanut (Arachis hypogaea L.) Yield in Saline-Alkali Soil
pmc-13414928.creator: Yang Xu, Chen Zhang, Zipeng Yu, Qing Guo, Feifei Qin, Ming Li, Zhimeng Zhang, Hong Ding
pmc-13414928.description: Background: Peanuts (Arachis hypogaea L.) cultivated in saline-alkali areas frequently endure drought stress. Yet, mechanistic research on combined salt–drought stress for peanut growth and yield remains scarce. Methods: A pot culture experiment was conducted to investigate the impacts of short-term drought imposed at the flowering stage on peanuts grown in saline-alkali soil.

pmc-13449669.title: Development and characterization of an Indacaterol/Tiotropium Bromide composite dry powder inhalation formulation for COPD
pmc-13449669.creator: Xiaobing Wang, Xiaoxi Xu, Chunlei Cheng, Jing Zheng, Wenkun Liu, Yuwen Xu, Jihang Xu, Lihua Wu, Xianhai Sun, Weijian Wang, Hao Fang
pmc-13449669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As a major public health issue, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) causes approximately 2.7 million deaths worldwide each year and has a significant negative impact on patients’ health. We have developed a novel long-acting fixed-dose combination dry powder inhalation formulation with synergistic therapeutic effects, containing indacaterol maleate (IND, a long-acting β2 agonist) and tiotropium bromide (TIO, a long-acting muscarinic receptor antagonist), aimed at improving the clinical management of COPD and providing patients with superior bronchodilator effects.

pmc-13573595.title: Plant Spatio-Temporal Integration Network (PSTN): a framework for dynamic single-cell and spatial transcriptomics in fungal–plant interactions
pmc-13573595.creator: Yuheng Zhu, Hao Zhang, Xianyu Zhang, Enshuang Zhao, Yinfei Dai, Hanbo Liu, Longyi Li, Xiyuan Mei, Yuxin Jin, Lenore Cowen

pmc-13598523.title: A rare case report: Malignant transformation of lichen planus
pmc-13598523.creator: HaiCheng He, Yongzhu Pu, Xunrui Zhao, Chengtao Feng, Yujie Du, Long Chen, Ran Xie
pmc-13598523.description: Lichen planus is a chronic inflammatory disease that mainly affects the skin and mucous membranes. Malignant transformation is uncommon and is most frequently reported in oral or genital lesions. We report a rare case of cutaneous lichen planus on the left lower leg that transformed into squamous cell carcinoma with left inguinal lymph node metastasis.

pmc-13715474.title: Deriving General Energy Predictors for Pnictogen Bonding
pmc-13715474.creator: Jan Langwald, Antonio Frontera
pmc-13715474.description: A comprehensive quantum chemical study is presented to derive energetic predictors for pnictogen (Pn) bonding interactions. We analyzed the interaction energies of the Lewis acids PnF3 and F2PnX, where Pn represents nitrogen through bismuth and X represents chlorine, bromine, or iodine, acting as σ‐hole donors with a diverse set of up to twenty‐one different nitrogen‐ and oxygen‐based Lewis bases.
